subject: The story that stopped our team cold
preview_text: How one founder used Smart Notes to save her startup's biggest deal. You'll want to read this.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday, a founder emailed us a story that made our entire team stop and read. She'd been on the verge of losing a critical partnership because her team kept forgetting action items from calls. Then she used Smart Notes on a 3 AM meeting with a potential investor. The transcript caught a key commitment her team missed, and she followed up the next morning with a perfect summary. The deal closed that week.

That's the kind of clarity we built this app for. Not just to save you time rewriting notes, but to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Her team now uses the structured summary feature religiously—key points and action items right there, no hunting through messy notes.

You already have Smart Notes on your phone. The feature that saved her deal? One-tap recording plus the structured summary. It turns chaos into next steps, fast. Try it on your next call or lecture—just tap record, and let the AI do the rest.

Open the app and record one meeting today. See how it feels to leave with crystal-clear next steps. P.S. Her startup's name? She said we could share it: 'NexGen Logistics.' They're now on Premium, and their team has never missed an action item since.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary
